title: High-dimensional transfer learning with unaligned ordinal responses
abstract: arXiv:2611.20411v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this work, we study high-dimensional transfer learning with unaligned ordinal responses, allowing different domain-specific regression coefficients, cumulative links and thresholds. We develop the sample-split and full-target algorithms that pool source and target likelihoods and then estimate a target correction. Under suitable conditions, our algorithms achieve minimax-optimal rates for parameter estimation and excess risk. Simulations favor the full-target algorithm over the sample-split algorithm for finite-sample estimation and prediction. An application to a medical dataset further demonstrates the predictive gains of our full-target algorithm over the target-only and pooled baselines when transferring information from the five-category source data to binary hospital mortality.

translated_title: 非对齐有序响应的高维迁移学习
translated_abstract: 在这项工作中，我们研究了具有非对齐有序响应的高维迁移学习问题，允许源域和目标域拥有不同的回归系数、累积连接和阈值。我们开发了样本分割和全目标两种算法，它们先合并源域和目标域的似然，再估计目标域校正项。在适当条件下，我们的算法在参数估计和超额风险方面均达到极小化极大最优速率。仿真结果表明，在有限样本估计和预测任务中，全目标算法优于样本分割算法。在一个医学数据集上的应用进一步表明，当从五分类源数据向二分类住院死亡率迁移信息时，我们的全目标算法相比仅使用目标数据和简单合并数据的基线方法均取得了更好的预测效果。
tldr: 该论文针对源域与目标域有序响应类别不对齐的高维迁移学习问题，提出了样本分割和全目标两种算法，实现了参数估计与超额风险的极小化极大最优速率，并在医学数据上验证了有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes sample-split and full-target algorithms for high-dimensional transfer learning with unaligned ordinal responses, achieving minimax-optimal rates for parameter estimation and excess risk, with demonstrated gains on medical data.
